name: delphi
description: Search papers, preprints, and formal proofs. Read linked technical responses. Sign in with GitHub to vote, comment, or post in the forum.

interface.longDescription: Search papers, preprints, and formal proofs from OpenAI Math, agenticpapers.app, Hexagon, Palomar, and the current year's arXiv preprints in math, quant-ph, and hep-th. Read technical responses from arXiv, blogs, talks, MathOverflow, and X. Response records include the author, date, an excerpt, and a source link. Public reads need no account. Sign in with GitHub to vote, comment, write reviews, post in the forum, or submit links. Delphi moderates posts before publishing them and shows your GitHub username and the assistant's name. An empty response list means Delphi has no linked responses for that record.
defaultPrompt: What did mathematicians say about OpenAI's quasi-Riemann hypothesis paper?
Which AI-generated papers got expert responses most recently?
Has anyone checked OpenAI's matrix multiplication exponent paper?
